data.name: GDP by sector (World Bank WDI)
data.description: World Bank GDP by sector (agriculture, industry, services) at country (admin0) level, expressed in constant 2015 US dollars. Derived from the World Bank World Development Indicators. Used to characterise the share of national output linked to agriculture in each country.

data.name: Land-use shares (FAOSTAT)
data.description: FAOSTAT country-level land-use shares (cropland, forest, other) for SSA countries. Used to characterise the relative weight of agricultural land in each country.

data.name: Subnational poverty rates (World Bank GSAP 2023)
data.description: Subnational poverty rates from the World Bank Global Subnational Atlas of Poverty (GSAP), 2023 release. Reports the share of population below the $2.15 and $3.65 per day (2017 PPP) international poverty lines at admin0 and admin1 levels across Africa.

data.name: Historical climate timeseries 1995–2014 (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6)
data.description: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 historical scenario (model hindcast) for 1995–2014. Ensemble mean across 18 GCMs (r1i1p1f1) of monthly hazard indices summarised over rolling 3-month seasonal windows at admin1 resolution for Africa. Year-by-year variability is the GCMs' own; only the climatology is calibrated against the GMFD reanalysis upstream.

data.name: Future climate timeseries 2021–2100 (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6, 4 periods)
data.description: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 future projections across four 20-year periods (2021–2040, 2041–2060, 2061–2080, 2081–2100). For each period, ensemble mean and inter-model min–max across 18 GCMs (r1i1p1f1) under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, and SSP5-8.5. Monthly hazard indices summarised over rolling 3-month seasonal windows at admin1 resolution. Anomalies computed against the 1995–2014 baseline.

data.name: Hazard exposure of crops and livestock (Atlas-harmonised)
data.description: Subnational value of production (nominal 2021 USD) intersected with the occurrence of severe single- and multi-hazard events (drought via NDWS, heat via NTx35 / THI-max, waterlogging via NDWL0). Crop-specific severity thresholds use FAO Ecocrop optimum and absolute limits; the seasonal window per crop is the GGCMI Phase 3 maize calendar (Jägermeyr et al. 2021). Hazard occurrence is the NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 ensemble mean per scenario × period.

data.name: Crop + livestock value of production (MapSPAM 2020 v1r2 SSA + GLW4)
data.description: Combined crop and livestock value of production at admin1, harmonised by the Adaptation Atlas. Crops come from MapSPAM 2020 v1r2 SSA (the Adaptation Atlas commissioned variant); livestock from the FAO Gridded Livestock of the World v4 (2020). Values are reported in nominal 2021 US dollars across the harmonised commodity list used by all Atlas notebooks.
